# Raytracer dependencies

`srBase.Mod` and `srRayEngine.Mod` are Soren Renner's A2 voxel raytracer modules,
copied from [MiniA2](https://github.com/active-oberon/minia2), revision
`39023192139c0b49f18aaade17e40fd065a391b7`, `source/`, with the modern
`SIGNED32` / `SIGNED16` / `FLOAT32` type names already used there.
They are included here so a fresh checkout does not need a sibling A2 source tree.
See `LICENSE.txt` for the A2 distribution's copyright notice and license.
